title: Model, data and figures for: Cascaded heat utilisation from small modular reactors for desalination, aquaculture and food production: a techno-economic assessment for France
description: Monthly screening model of six French coastal SMR hubs comparing a multi-effect-distillation heat cascade with heat pumps on the main condenser, with purchased water and with seawater reverse osmosis, on consolidated accounts without heat credits, with firm heat supply and a monthly water balance through reactor and distillation outages. Includes model code, 387 consistency tests, Monte Carlo draws (2,000 draws, 40 inputs), a two-dimensional sensitivity, all outputs as CSV/JSON and scripts that regenerate every figure and document. Sea temperatures, greenhouse climate factors and the outage schedule are illustrative screening inputs.
notes: Licences: the record (data, figures, text) is CC BY 4.0; all code files (Code/model, Code/build) are MIT-licensed as stated in LICENSE.
